overview.description: The KraneShares Hedgeye Hedged Equity Index ETF (KSPY) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Hedgeye Hedged Equity index. The fund tracks an index the provides exposure to the S&P 500, with the objective of reducing volatility and dynamically hedging downside risk. The underlying portfolio holds ETFs with exposure to the S&P 500 Index, a fund-of-funds, and weekly Index options KSPY was launched on Jul 16, 2024 and is issued by KraneShares.
